text: erin: Quick sync: need a tight bench narrative for launch post + 12-min webinar. One hero stat, two supporting visuals, and clear inbound routing. mike: I'll take the hero stat + short headline. prefer absolute $/1k and a p95 callout. sofia: Ill design the hero + social square. two-tone: cool for latency, warm for cost. benchbot: Latest run (2024-11-15): hosted p50=150ms p95=480ms; dedicated p50=95ms p95=210ms; cost hosted=$0.030/1k; dedicated=$0.018/1k. CSV:/internal/bench/launch/2024-11-15.csv erin: mike can you convert those into a 1-line hero and a 70-char tweetable headline? mike: Draft hero: "Dedicated: $0.018/1k vs Hosted: $0.030/1k • lower cost, lower tail latency (p95)" — will trim for tweet. sofia: Visual notes: left: p50/p95 lines; right: $/1k bars by prompt family (short/mid/long). annotate mid prompt used in demo. tara: Landing routing: two CTAs, "Try Hosted" (self-serve) and "Request Dedicated" (sales). add utm=bench_launch_v1 and a one-line workload qualifier when sales selected. erin: Compliance note: add footnote "N=400 requests across 3 runs, A100-80GB; see appendix" mike: Will add footnote + link to appendix CSV. sofia: Need figma frames by EOD Tue to hit Wed deck draft. benchbot: Appendix uploaded: /internal/bench/launch/2024-11-15-appendix.md (run IDs, prompts, hardware, runtime v2.6). erin: Action items: mike hero copy + tweet trim (EOD Mon); sofia figma frames + alt text (EOD Tue); tara form + utm routing (Wed AM); sam (ops) to confirm demo canned numbers (Wed AM). erin: Keep claims conservative — prefer $/1k + p95 numbers and pointer to appendix. :rocket:
